name: Team Rocket’s Wobbuffet
flavor: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

attacks.name: Rocket Frenzy
attacks.effect: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has “Team Rocket” in its name. Shuffle the revealed cards back into your deck.
